note: GD.40 include-style route mounts. proj/urls.py includes app.urls under `api/` and app.auth_urls under `auth/` by dotted module path; app/urls/__init__.py spreads `*issue_urls` (`from .issue import urlpatterns as issue_urls`) and includes app.urls.nested under `v2/`. Each Django pattern is a ROUTE at its full path, located at its `path(..)` call, and the include() lines mint no ROUTE. The TS client calls pair exactly by path (a Django ROUTE is ANY).
